correctness.rationale: This verdict is for the replacement RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md under /workspace/repairs/3/. The frozen proof invoked Zou's Lemma 6.1 outside its noetherian setup and relied on line bundles beyond the reduction used in its proof. The repaired argument keeps the tensor-power and Cartier conclusions at the stated generality. For a smooth proper morphism, Stacks Lemma 36.30.1 makes Rf_*O perfect and gives arbitrary derived base change. Over a local ring at a point cancel unit differentials in a bounded finite free representative, lifting the finite changes of basis to a neighborhood. Its minimal complex has fibre with zero differentials; Hodge-goodness forces all odd free terms to be zero and all indicated even terms to have rank one. Thus the remaining differentials vanish over the actual base and all E_i are lines with underived base change there. The cup-power maps are isomorphisms by testing every fibre. Relative Frobenius on O preserves cup product, so h_i·F_S^*c_i=c_i·h_1^{⊗i} as morphisms over S, including on a nonreduced base. Locally the zero ideals are (a^i), with a regular when S is integral and the geometric splitting locus is nonempty. On geometric fibres the top map detects splitting; Zou's fibrewise Corollary 4.16 gives the height dichotomy (also used in Theorem 6.7). The replacement removes the unqualified claim that an empty splitting locus implies identically zero sections: pointwise vanishing only implies locally nilpotent coefficients on a nonreduced base. No computation is required.
residual_risks: Cartier divisors under the stated integrality and nonempty-splitting assumptions may be empty. The claim does not transfer to non-Hodge-good fibres or determine reducedness of D1.

value.rationale: The top coherent Frobenius section is already a natural detector of geometric splitting. Its zeros alone leave their scheme structure undetermined. On a family where the Cartier divisor is present the exact equality with nD1 shows that it is a nonreduced thickening and identifies every higher local vanishing ideal from degree two, separating multiplicity forced by cup power from any intrinsic multiplicity of D1. This gives useful scheme-level information even though the comparison proof is short and makes no claim about reducedness of the defining lower divisor.
residual_risks: Does not establish that D1 is nonempty for every such family and does not compute its own local geometry or the broader height stratification.
